title: nan
authors: Prell R.; Rubio R.; Joseph S.; Negash N.; Sun L.
key_contribution: Presents a unified decision-making framework coupling resilient multimodal localization (VIO, SLAM) with energy-aware planning and contingency logic for UAV response to GPS loss in BVLOS operations.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Filter_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
